metaDescription: Order custom 3 xlarge buttons in bulk. Perfect for events, promotions, and branding. Get a quick quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Custom 3 xlarge buttons give your message maximum visibility. At 3 inches in diameter, these oversized buttons are ideal for trade shows, rallies, and retail promotions where you need your logo or slogan to stand out from across the room. Choose from a variety of backing options, including pin backs or magnetic closures, and print in full color on durable metal. Whether you are outfitting a team or creating a giveaway for thousands, the larger canvas ensures crisp detail and bold impact that smaller buttons simply cannot match.
heroAltText: Custom 3 xlarge buttons with full-color print and pin backing on a white background
